subject: general
question: In which year did the Indian National Congress split into two groups on the banks of River Tapti at The Surat Session?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1907.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Surat split**

 
 
• The Congress split at Surat took place in the year **1907** in the month of **December.**
 
• The Surat split was the splitting of the Indian National Congress into two groups:
 
 
• the **Extremists**
 
• the **Moderates**
 
 
 
• The Extremists were led by **Lokmanya Tilak, Lajpat Rai **and **Shri Aurobindo.**
 
• The Moderates were led by **Gopal Krishna Gokhale, Pherozeshah Mehta **and **Surendranath Banerjee.**
 
• The Surat session was presided by Dr. rash Behari Ghosh.
 
• **1885-1905** was known as the** period of Moderates** because they dominated the Indian National Congress.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **In 1907 **the Surat session was held at the** bank of the Tapti river** in Surat.
 
• **Dr. Rash Behari Ghosh** was elected in the session but extremists had an objection to this election.
 
• Initially the extremists protested against the election but soon they accepted Dr. Rash Behari Ghosh as the president and offered to cooperate.
 
• But the session was suspended. Congress got split.
 
• By the time, the next session of Congress was held in Madras in **1908 **under Dr. Rash Behari Ghosh.
 
• It was the extremist camp that was facing the Lathis and arrest by the British Government who was now in its comfortable position as Congress was divided.
